findings.summary: The TestEligible doc comment still names the excluded set as {sdd, review, delivery}. The commit added `odd` and `session` to the set but did not update this comment. The commit's other prefix enumerations were updated, but this one was missed.
evidence: eligible_test.go:16 reads 'outside the excluded {sdd, review, delivery} set'.
eligible.go:20-26 now lists five prefixes: sdd, review, delivery, odd, session.
Read eligible.go in full. The map now has five entries and curatedTopicKey does an exact match on the first segment after TopicWithoutGoal.

Grep for Eligible( callers shows three: sync.go:170 and sync_cards.go:108 pass explicit=false, and writer.go:189 passes the explicit flag from the promote path. A pin or an explicit promote therefore still overrides the exclusion.

doctor_eligibility.go:90 calls IneligibleReason, which delegates to Eligible, so doctor stays consistent with the rule. The reason text '...is not a curated topic' still fits. The eligible.go:42 comment lists the five prefixes.
eligible_test.go covers odd/ excluded, session/ excluded, a pinned odd/ memory still eligible, and odd-notes/ not excluded (first segment is odd-notes, not odd).

Docs naming all five prefixes: openspec/specs/longterm-mem-promotion/spec.md:24, longterm-mem/README.md:87 and :171, longterm-mem/docs/sync-from-memorycard.md:28. A repo-wide grep (archive/ and odd/ excluded) found no other enumeration of the prefixes.
I did not run the test suite.
Risk 3 side effects as stated in the commit: pages already promoted are not retracted, and doctor now warns on them. The README documents this. I found no defect here.
